secrets.name: The Reading Room Outside the Loop
secrets.text: Behind the bookcase that is the same as every other bookcase there is a quiet room, and in it nothing repeats: one chair, one lamp, one book open at a page you have not read. You sit for a while. The corridor goes on without you.

meta.label: The Repeating Door
meta.blurb: A doorway, and beyond it a doorway, and beyond that one another, each with a single book lying on the floor in front of it. You pick up the book. The next doorway has one too.
